note: God's love is shown in the giving of his Son.
God's providence works toward the good of those who love him.
Nothing in creation can separate believers from God's love in Christ.
The Lord is pictured as the shepherd who provides and cares for his people.
Scripture begins with God's creation of all things.
Faith, hope, and love endure as central Christian virtues.
Christ invites the weary to receive rest and come to him.
The risen Christ sends his disciples to make disciples and teach the nations.
God is presented as a dependable refuge and source of help in trouble.
Trust in God directs the believer's way rather than self-reliance.
The suffering servant bears sin and brings healing and peace.
Salvation is received by grace through faith, not earned by works.
